channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Real estate in Indian markets. Today: strong headwind (−6.4).

item.title: [−3] RBI joins global central banks in tightening cycle; 2 more rate hikes likely by February
item.description:
Signal: RBI tightening (India). 76 reports from The Times of India, Telegraph India, Reuters and 53 more. Related: “10-year bond yield steady after RBI rate hike, tracking global cues”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 3 Oct).

Real estate: strong headwind (−3) — Home loans get dearer

Why it matters: A higher repo rate lifts loan rates for homes, vehicles and businesses and pushes up bond yields, though it supports the rupee and lenders' margins at first.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [−1] Global bond sell-off pushes U.S. Treasury yields to fresh 24-year highs
item.description:
